finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker could input a malicious filename that includes command injection vectors (e.g., `round-1.csv; rm -rf /`)
finding.assumptions: The `File.Exists()` and file operations are executed in a context where the attacker could manipulate the file system or execute arbitrary commands.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker could input a malicious response that includes command injection vectors (e.g., `y; rm -rf /`)
finding.assumptions: The `Directory.GetFiles()` and file operations are executed in a context where the attacker could manipulate the file system or execute arbitrary commands.

finding.assumptions: The `Console.WriteLine()` is executed in a context where the attacker could manipulate the command line or execute arbitrary commands.
